subject: Seed cache savings & pilot — post-discovery next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seed cache savings & pilot — post-discovery next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on:

- Volumes: you indicated 1.2M active users/month, ~120M generation tokens/month today, with peak windows that can double short-term.
- Target unit econ: you mentioned a target of roughly $5k–$10k per 1M tokens in production (goal: < $7k / 1M long-term).
- Seed cache approach we discussed: proactively 'seed' hot prefixes and conversational starters for high-frequency cohorts (session-level prefetch + cohort prewarming). This differs from pure prefix-only caching because we preload predicted continuations for common flows.
- Initial hit-rate expectation: we proposed a conservative planning range of 15–45% depending on cohort granularity and session behavior.

Immediate next steps:
1) I attached the working seed_cache_model_v1.xlsx with scenario lines for 10/25/40% hit rates and the resulting effective $/1M tokens. Please review assumptions in the 'Inputs' tab.
2) Can you confirm the monthly spend band you feel comfortable piloting with (range is fine)? You mentioned possibly testing at ~$50k/month or higher.
3) We're happy to run a 4-week pilot scoped to a single feature (search-summarize flow). If that sounds good, we'll send a short mutual action plan and a demo for instrumentation.

If you want, we can also convert the model to your exact traffic slices — I can have Ben and Marissa pull cohort examples.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com
Attachment: seed_cache_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — short summary rows copied from the model (seed-cache vs no-cache, effective price per 1M gen tokens):

- No cache baseline: $9,500 / 1M tokens (current mix + no prefix prefetch)
- Seed-cache conservative (15% hit): $7,950 / 1M tokens
- Seed-cache mid (30% hit): $6,400 / 1M tokens
- Seed-cache aggressive (50% hit): $4,900 / 1M tokens

Notes on assumptions: the model assumes a 20% reduction in compute per served token on hits (because KV lookups bypass generation for predicted spans) and modest extra storage/transfer costs for prefetching. The attached workbook breaks the calc down per-token and includes cohort-weighted projections.

I’ve uploaded a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW here:
- MA plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/seed-cache-model (one-pager)
- Detailed model (same workbook): seed_cache_model_v1.xlsx (attached)

Next steps: I’ll follow up with Ben to scope instrumentation for the pilot and will draft a pilot pricing line that maps to your $60k–$100k band. Can we book a 30-min pricing run-through Thursday?

Best,
Rachel
Attachment: redwood_ma_plan.pdf (PDF)
